text:
```yaml
name: Claude Auto-Fix CI Implementation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Lint code
      run: npm run lint

    - name: Fix linting issues
      run: npm run fix

    - name: Commit fixes
      uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
      with:
        add: .
        commit: "chore: auto-fix linting issues"
        push: true
```

This workflow will automatically run on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch. It checks out the code, sets up Node.js, installs dependencies, runs tests, lints the code, attempts to fix linting issues, and commits any fixes back to the repository.
